text:
Maya: Alright folks, Very Serious Question(tm): which editor deserves the office crown? 👑
James: Quick rules — reply with one emoji that represents your pick, i'll tally. Keep it light. :smile:
Omar: Vim = :trident: (for the ancient sea wizard energy)
Sarah: VSCode = :blue_book: — cozy and powerful
Anya: Emacs = :octopus: (tentacles for days)
James: Nano = :seedling: (tiny but scrappy)
DevBot: Poll started by Maya. React or reply with your emoji to vote. Poll ends in 2 hours.
Maya: My vote: :blue_book: (VSCode)
Omar: Confirming :trident:
James: Changing to :octopus: for balance (switcheroo)
Anya: :octopus: locked in
Sarah: :blue_book: from me too
DevBot: Interim tally — VSCode :blue_book: 2, Emacs :octopus: 2, Vim :trident: 1, Nano :seedling: 0
Maya: Proposal: if Emacs wins, we make a tiny shrine in the breakroom. if VSCode wins, we get stickers. :thinking_face:
James: Deal. Also wager: whoever loses has to run a 2-minute demo of the winner editor in All-Hands. :grimacing:
Omar: Love this chaos. :laughing:
DevBot: Poll closed. Final tally — VSCode :blue_book: 2, Emacs :octopus: 2, Vim :trident: 1, Nano :seedling: 0. Tie between VSCode and Emacs!
Maya: BRACKET TIME. quick 1v1 demo face-off next Tuesday during lunch?
Sarah: I'm bringing sandwiches for the audience if we do it. :sandwich:
Anya: Emacs demo ready. Will bring an octopus plush for moral support. :octopus:
James: VSCode will come with a sticker pack. May the best editor win. :crown:
